posts.title: Why creativity matters in data visualisation
posts.description: At the end of July, I delivered one of this year’s Ihaka Lectures at the University of Auckland. posts.title: Chord diagrams in R with ggchord2
posts.description: Chord diagrams are a type of chart that can be used to show relationships or flows between categories. A chord diagram is a circular chart that displays connections between categories using curved ribbons drawn inside a circle.
